name: kiba_conv
description: KIBA convergence re-run (§8.3 non-convergence fix). Three principled changes vs kiba.json: (1) ligand-conditional early-stop on val_per_lig_auc instead of the retired val_global_auc -- KIBA's ~2k-ligand val split makes per-ligand AUC well-sampled (the n=2 noise caveat applies only to BRENDA-200); (2) hard_pool_size 50 -> 120, ~75% of KIBA's ~160 train proteins (50 was ~31%, below the recipe's >=50% coverage rule); (3) longer patience/min-epochs. Original run: per-lig AUC 0.457, pos>maxneg plateaued at 0.57.
